subject: th-cont
title: TH.CONT.-----PROJ.DY-----AFL.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 444 (MP(I)-18). TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the subject; PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and AFL (affinity alignment) are the partners in the title. From PROJ-DY: AFL and PRI-INFO (principle information). From AFL: SOC-RT (social reality) and ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism). From PRI-INFO: AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and ISTF. From ALT-C-PG: CN-INFO (controlled information). From ISTF: AFTO. From CN-INFO: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions).
